paper_title: New ALPS Results on Hidden-Sector Lightweights
coupling_convention: g_agamma (g-) in GeV^-1, pseudoscalar ALP-photon coupling
notes: ALPS-I LSW experiment at DESY (2010). Paper reports 95% CL limits on photon-WISP-photon conversion probability (Table 1: e.g. 2.25e-25 for magnet on, parallel polarization, vacuum). No numerical table of g vs mass is given; exclusion curves are in Fig. 4. Data points above are reconstructed: the low-mass plateau g- ~ 6.5e-8 GeV^-1 was computed from the quoted probability limit via P_total = (g*B*l/2)^4 with B=5 T, l=4.3 m, omega=2.33 eV; the high-mass shape (coherence loss beyond ~5e-4 eV, gaps filled by Ar gas runs with n-1 ~ 5e-8) is approximate from Fig. 4 envelope. Paper also sets limits on scalar ALPs (g+), hidden photon kinetic mixing chi (Fig. 5), and minicharged particles Q (Fig. 6) — only the pseudoscalar ALP-photon limit is extracted here per the hint.
